channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: All of Catalina's deer will be killed to restore the island's ecosystem
item.description: Starting as soon as September, a squad of 10 to 12 trained professionals bound by state regulations will descend on Catalina to hunt the deer with rifles.

item.title: Brothers of Renee Good describe family’s grief, urge action at Democratic forum on ICE force
item.description: Democrats heard from three U.S. citizens who are residents of San Bernardino, Chicago and Minneapolis. Also present were two brothers and an attorney representing the family of Renee Good, the 37-year-old mother of three who was killed by a federal agent in Minneapolis last month.

item.title: L.A. parents who decapitated two of their kids, forced siblings to view the bodies, are sentenced
item.description: A Lancaster couple who decapitated their 12- and 13-year-old children in 2020 were sentenced to life without parole Monday.

item.title: Attorneys for man killed by off-duty ICE agent call on California A.G. to investigate
item.description: Attorneys for Keith Porter Jr. — who was shot and killed by an off-duty ICE agent on New Year's Eve — called for California Atty. Gen. Rob Bonta to take over the investigation of the incident, claiming the LAPD won't conduct a fair review.

item.title: L.A. stopped a couple from demolishing Marilyn Monroe's home. Now, they're suing
item.description: The owners of the Brentwood home where Marilyn Monroe died in 1962 are suing the city of L.A. and Mayor Karen Bass for the right to demolish the property.

item.title: Clippers trade James Harden to Cavaliers for Darius Garland
item.description: Along with the young point guard from Cleveland, the Clippers will also receive a second-round draft pick from the team.

item.title: Statewide human trafficking crackdown led to hundreds of arrests, L.A. authorities say
item.description: Top law enforcement officials in Los Angeles said they mobilized federal, state and local agencies throughout California, arresting suspects on suspicion of sex crimes and ensuring that victims were "safely rescued."

item.title: Savannah Guthrie will no longer be part of NBC's Winter Olympics coverage
item.description: The 'Today' co-host will remain in the U.S. as law enforcement officials continue to search for her mother, Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie’s mom 'taken,' sheriff says; blood drops are found and ransom questions raised
item.description: Details continue to emerge about the apparent kidnapping of Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: L.A. politicians call on Casey Wasserman to resign from Olympics committee
item.description: L.A. County Supervisor Janice Hahn said controversy around LA28 head Casey Wasserman is a distraction.
